comment: Human-authored. The loop reads this once at start and never writes it.
Every entry must name a committed pre-registration; the loop refuses an
entry whose prereg file does not exist. Commands are argv lists, never
shell strings -- a shell string in a committed queue is an injection
surface for anyone who can open a pull request.
'expect' is recorded in the self-transfer ledger BEFORE the run, so that
what an iteration believed it was doing can be compared afterwards with
what it produced. The loop never makes that comparison itself.
